speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The clinical presentation of fever, headache, anorexia, and malaise in a 30-week pregnant patient, combined with the specific history of consuming unpasteurized dairy products (ice cream) three days prior, is highly characteristic of listeriosis. This is a medical emergency requiring immediate isolation and IV antibiotic therapy (ampicillin) to prevent fetal sepsis and loss.
